apps.title: Image to SVG
apps.description: Local image-to-SVG conversion with 22 methods, continuous line drawings, fine controls, and palette limits.

params.label: Conversion method
params.description: 22 tracing, mosaic, halftone, and continuous-line methods. Image previews and ordered filters are in the image tab.

params.label: Maximum shapes
params.description: Caps drawing elements across the whole image. Transparency may add one shared clip path.

params.label: Sampling cells (0 = automatic)
params.description: Set a sampling target directly, independently of Detail. Zero uses automatic density. Maximum shapes and image resolution still bound the result.

params.label: Sample cell aspect ratio
params.description: Relative width of sampling cells: above 1 favors wider cells; below 1 favors taller cells.

params.label: Boundary simplification
params.description: Reduces contour vertices while preserving closed paths.

params.label: Minimum region / hole area (px²)
params.description: Remove tiny contour islands and holes below this area in prepared-image pixels. Zero keeps all regions.

params.label: Corner rounding
params.description: Scales the local rounding of smooth contour corners. Zero keeps sharp corners.

params.label: Quadtree color tolerance
params.description: Higher values allow more color variation inside each unsplit block. Detail and the shape budget still limit subdivision.

params.label: Minimum block size (px)
params.description: Stop subdividing blocks at this size in prepared-image pixels.

params.label: Tile inset
params.description: Shrinks each tile inward by this fraction, leaving gaps between tiles.

params.label: Mark size
params.description: Scales dot radii or square sides. Large marks can overlap.

params.label: Darkness response
params.description: Changes how source darkness affects mark coverage. Higher values leave more space in midtones.

params.label: Minimum darkness
params.description: Skip marks in areas lighter than this darkness. Zero includes the full tonal range.

params.label: Stipple density multiplier
params.description: Control how many candidate dots survive tone-weighted sampling. Sampling cells sets the candidate count.

params.label: Hatch angle
params.description: Rotates hatch strokes; crosshatching adds a second direction in dark areas.

params.label: Crosshatch darkness threshold
params.description: Only areas darker than this value get the second hatch direction.

params.label: Crosshatch crossing angle
params.description: Angle between the two hatch directions, independently of the base hatch angle.

params.label: Stroke length multiplier
params.description: Change stroke length without changing its width or the sample grid.

params.label: Edge contrast threshold
params.description: Suppress boundaries whose RGB color distance falls below this threshold.

params.label: Stroke width
params.description: Width in prepared-image pixels for continuous lines; a width multiplier for the short-stroke methods.

params.label: Voronoi cell count
params.description: Request 1–30,000 cells. The default direct-count mode does not reduce this with Detail. Increase Maximum shapes for counts above its limit. Transparent cells may be absent.

params.label: Voronoi count mode
params.description: Direct count uses the requested cell count; the other mode scales it with Detail.

params.label: Voronoi site jitter
params.description: Zero uses regular cell centers; higher values create more irregular cells using Random seed.

params.label: Voronoi cell aspect
params.description: Stretch the initial site distribution into wider or taller cells.

params.label: Voronoi relaxation passes
params.description: Move sites toward their cell centroids for more even spacing. Extra passes take longer.

params.label: Continuous line count
params.description: Total continuous paths, capped by Maximum shapes. Each path uses one ink color. Fully transparent paths are omitted.

params.label: Total line colors (maximum)
params.description: Maximum distinct colors across all lines, limited by Color bins, available image colors, and line count. One makes a single-ink drawing.

params.label: Line color assignment
params.description: Distributed colors use squiggle density to emphasize each ink’s image regions. Dominant mode picks the strongest local color for each path.

params.label: Samples per line
params.description: More samples retain finer waves. Detail scales this value; a total limit of 250,000 samples bounds SVG size.

params.label: Squiggle amplitude
params.description: Width of the sideways waves. Zero follows the underlying route without waves.

params.label: Base wave frequency
params.description: Base oscillations along each path. Increase Samples per line when using very tight waves.

params.label: Extra density in dark areas
params.description: Add more oscillations in dark regions; zero keeps wave frequency constant.

params.label: Minimum wave coverage
params.description: Residual wave amplitude in light or off-color regions. The path stays connected even at zero.

params.label: Drawing angle
params.description: Rotate the drawing around the image center; coordinates remain inside the image.

params.label: Curve smoothing
params.description: Round path corners with quadratic curves. Zero exports straight segments.

params.label: Rows per ribbon
params.description: Back-and-forth traversals within each continuous ribbon.

params.label: Total spiral turns
params.description: Total turns across the whole spiral, divided among the requested lines.

params.label: Flow travel distance
params.description: Travel distance of each thread in multiples of the image’s short edge.

params.label: Follow image edges
params.description: Steer flow along local image edges. Zero uses only the seeded flow field.

params.label: Hilbert subdivision level
params.description: Each level doubles the traversal grid width and height. Increase Samples per line to resolve higher levels.

params.label: Color bins (maximum)
params.description: Maximum total palette colors (2–64). Black and white uses at most two; sparse outputs may use fewer.

params.label: Working resolution (long edge)
params.description: Long edge after cropping, up to 1024 pixels. Small images are not enlarged.

params.label: Crop left (0–1)
params.description: Crop values are fractions of the original image: 0.25 = 25%. Crops stop at the image edges.
